title: Chain-of-Custody Log
description: Full pickup-to-delivery record for a facility, team, or date range, including photo references and driver IDs.

title: Photo Proof Log
description: Indexed pickup and delivery photos for a route, facility, or specific tray/bin, for rapid dispute resolution.

title: Tray & Bin Movement Log
description: Quantity movement across facilities over time, useful for inventory reconciliation and utilization review.

title: Delivery Time Report
description: On-time performance by route, facility, and driver, benchmarked against your service-level agreement.

title: Incident Log
description: Every flagged exception with category, facility, timestamp, and resolution status.
